meta.name: cyberedge-correlate-cves
meta.description: Correlate exact, evidence-backed CPE identities already observed by CyberEdge with normalized NVD CVE records. Use when an AI operator must run CVE intelligence for an authorized Scope, interpret CVSS metadata and lifecycle state, or distinguish completed CPE coverage from missing identity or provider failure without guessing products or versions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 关联已知CPE身份与NVD漏洞记录，获取精准CVE情报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在授权范围内运行CVE情报并区分已覆盖与缺失的CPE
copy.tagline_en: Correlate known CPE identities with NVD CVE records for precise intelligence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run CVE intelligence for an authorized scope and distinguish covered from missing CPEs

howto.what: Claude能根据你授权的网站资产中已识别的软件版本（CPE），自动关联标准化的CVE漏洞情报，并报告漏洞的严重性、状态、证据来源及生命周期。
howto.when: 当你拥有一个授权范围且已有技术指纹（含精确CPE），需要分析CVE情报时，可以要求Claude运行此技能。

say.text: 请分析我授权网站的CVE漏洞。
say.note: Claude将启动CVE情报扫描并关联CPE。

say.text: 报告当前范围的漏洞覆盖情况。
say.note: Claude区分已完成覆盖和未知覆盖。

howto.what_en: Claude correlates observed CPEs from authorized assets with normalized NVD CVE records, reports CVSS scores, lifecycle status, evidence sources, and distinguishes completed coverage from unknown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to run CVE intelligence for an authorized scope that has TechnologyFingerprints with exact CPEs.

say_en.text: Analyze CVE vulnerabilities for my authorized websites.
What CVEs correspond to this CPE?
say_en.note: Claude queries NVD and returns results.

say_en.text: Report coverage status for current scope.
say_en.note: Claude identifies completed and unknown coverage.
